between_days.fork: The Meadow's Fork — choose one road: Wildflower Shrine (trade 20 honey: +1 heart now, +8 bees), Quiet Meadow (no toll, small gift +6 honey/+3 bees), Apiary Market (buy relics, blessings, hive mending)
between_days.upgrade: after each day, choose 1 of 3 upgrades (12 in the pool)

caveats: No human playtest yet — all playthroughs are by the automated bot (competent but not human: perfect aim, instant reactions). A human will score lower and may find the keeper harder to keep alive.

Screenshots 02-04 are staged via ?shot= (documented in sim.js stageShot): the play shot is a mid-day-5 state, the victory shot uses staged stats (score 96400, above the S bar of 90000). The title shot is a real fresh-profile load.

Honey economy is generous late-game: a strong run ends with several hundred honey, so the Apiary Market is trivially affordable by days 7-10. Early-game (days 1-4) honey is tight and the choices matter.

Total repo size ~436 KiB (game code ~92 KiB, screenshots ~248 KiB, vendored make.fun lib ~56 KiB) — below the top entries' 0.75-1.46 MB, but the systems depth is complete (10 days, 7 enemies, 3 bosses, 10 relics, 12 blessings, 12 upgrades, fork, market, 3 difficulties).

The bot takes the first upgrade and the Quiet Meadow fork every time; the other upgrade/fork/market paths are exercised by the playtest only through the market-buy-all step, not by a bot that weighs them.

controls.E: plant a flower patch (15 honey) — regrows bees and yields honey
controls.Space: smoke puff — pushes back and calms wasps in a radius (8s cooldown)
controls.mouse click/hold: direct the swarm to a point

core_mechanic: You are the Warden, a beekeeper defending the hives. The bee swarm is your weapon: click/hold the mouse to direct the swarm to a point — bees attack enemies there, then return. Bees die in combat; the hive regrows them over time and flowers accelerate it.

enemies.behavior: tiny and quick — 1 sting ends it
shielded from the front — circle it

progression.scoring: banish score + chain bonus (consecutive banishes within 4s) + day-clear bonuses (time left, hive HP, hearts); victory rank S >= 90000, A >= 65000, B >= 45000

resources.bees: swarm size; bees die in combat (12% sacrificial death per sting), hive regrows ~1 per 3.5s, flowers +0.25/s each, cap 40
resources.hearts: keeper HP (4 base); +1 heart rest on each day cleared; shrine and upgrades heal/extend
resources.honey: currency from banished enemies + flower blooms + boss bounties; spent on flowers, shrine, market

screens: title (how-to, bestiary, difficulty select, best stats)
playing HUD (hearts, bees, honey, day dots, timer, quota, incoming list, relics/blessings, control bar)

screenshots.what: mid-day gameplay, day 5 orchard, swarm vs wasps (staged via ?shot=play)
victory screen, S rank (staged via ?shot=victory; values self-consistent with the S bar)

structure.day_rule: Banish the day's quota of wasps before dusk. Lose if the keeper falls, the hive is destroyed, or dusk falls with the quota unmet. Boss days (5, 8, 10) also require the boss banished.

tagline: your swarm is your weapon; direct the bees through ten days across four meadows

verification.balance_history: day 1 was winnable by standing still (idle bee guard radius 150px) — fixed to 60px so directing the swarm matters; keeper died on day 5-6 — fixed with 4 base hearts, 1.2s hurt cooldown, chase enemies prefer the hive unless the keeper is within 140px, +1 heart rest on day clear; boss days now require the boss banished, not just the quota
